# weblate_component (Resource)

Manages a Weblate Component with its own repository.

Weblate strips leading and trailing whitespace from every string, so a value that differs from the stored one only in that whitespace causes no change. An attribute that the configuration omits is not managed: the provider reads it but never changes it. After create and update, the provider compares every configured attribute with the value Weblate stored and fails the apply when they differ; for `file_format_params` and `vcs_params` it names the keys that Weblate dropped or changed.

Changing `name` or `slug` renames the Component in place, and changing `category` moves it in place. Weblate cannot move a Component to another Project, so changing `project` to another Project fails on apply. When `project` changes because the Project was renamed, only the state changes.

Weblate processes a new or changed Component in a background task, such as cloning the repository and parsing the files. The provider waits for the task. When the task fails, the Component stays in Weblate and in state, the apply fails with the task's error and log, and after a create OpenTofu replaces the Component on the next apply. Delete waits until Weblate has removed the Component.

Create always sends `disable_autoshare`, so Weblate never turns a Component into a link to another Component with the same repository.

Weblate adds objects of its own on create, which the provider ignores unless the configuration declares them: it installs Add-ons that depend on the file format and the `DEFAULT_ADDONS` setting, and for the first Component of a Project it creates a glossary Component with the slug `glossary`, unless the Weblate setting `CREATE_GLOSSARIES` is off. To manage that glossary, import it, such as `docs/glossary`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "weblate_component" "app" {
  project     = weblate_project.docs.slug
  category    = weblate_category.guides.id
  name        = "App"
  slug        = "app"
  repo        = "https://github.com/example/app.git"
  branch      = "main"
  filemask    = "po/*.po"
  new_base    = "po/messages.pot"
  file_format = "po"

  file_format_params = jsonencode({
    po_line_wrap = -1
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_format` (String) File format of the translation files, such as `po` or `json`.
- `filemask` (String) Path of the translation files relative to the repository root, with `*` instead of the language code, such as `po/*.po`.
- `name` (String) Display name of the Component. Unique in the Project.
- `project` (String) Slug of the Project that holds the Component.
- `repo` (String) URL of the repository that Weblate clones.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the Component, as in its URL. Unique in the Project.

### Optional

- `allow_translation_propagation` (Boolean) Whether translations from other Components of the Project with the same source string are used in this one. Defaults to `true`.
- `auto_lock_error` (Boolean) Whether Weblate locks the Component on repository errors. Defaults to `true`.
- `branch` (String) Branch to translate. Defaults to the branch that `HEAD` of the repository points to.
- `category` (String) `id` of the Category that holds the Component, which is its slug path and must start with `project`. Without it, the Component is at the root of the Project.
- `check_flags` (String) Translation flags that customize the quality checks of the Component.
- `commit_pending_age` (Number) Hours after which Weblate commits pending changes. Defaults to `24`.
- `contribute_project_tm` (Boolean) Whether the Component's translations go into the translation memory of the Project. Defaults to `true`.
- `edit_template` (Boolean) Whether users can edit the base file of a monolingual format. Defaults to `true`. The converter formats `html`, `markdown`, `mdx`, `odf`, `idml`, `rc`, `txt`, `dokuwiki`, `mediawiki`, `asciidoc` and `wxl` need `false`; the provider does not check this at plan.
- `enable_suggestions` (Boolean) Whether users can make suggestions. Defaults to `true`.
- `file_format_params` (String) Settings of the file format as a JSON object, set with `jsonencode`.
- `glossary_color` (String) Color of a glossary, such as `silver`, the default.
- `hide_glossary_matches` (Boolean) Whether the translation editor hides the glossary panel.
- `intermediate` (String) Path of the intermediate language file of a monolingual format.
- `is_glossary` (Boolean) Whether the Component is a glossary.
- `key_filter` (String) Regular expression that selects the keys of a monolingual format.
- `language_regex` (String) Regular expression that selects the translation files found by `filemask`. Defaults to `^[^.]+$`.
- `manage_units` (Boolean) Whether users can add, remove and edit source strings in Weblate.
- `merge_style` (String) How Weblate brings in upstream changes: `rebase`, `merge` or `merge_noff`. Defaults to `rebase`.
- `new_base` (String) Path of the file from which Weblate creates new translations, such as a `.pot` file.
- `priority` (Number) Priority with which Weblate offers the Component to translators: `60` very high, `80` high, `100` medium, `120` low, `140` very low. Defaults to `100`.
- `push` (String) URL of the repository that Weblate pushes to. Weblate does not push when it is empty.
- `push_branch` (String) Branch that Weblate pushes to. Empty means `branch`.
- `push_on_commit` (Boolean) Whether Weblate pushes after every commit. Defaults to `true`.
- `push_on_update` (Boolean) Whether Weblate pushes after updating the repository, even without new translations. Defaults to `true`.
- `report_source_bugs` (String) E-mail address for reports on errors in source strings.
- `repoweb` (String) Link to a repository browser for source files, with the placeholders `{{branch}}`, `{{filename}}` and `{{line}}`.
- `repoweb_translations` (String) Link to a repository browser for translation files. Empty means `repoweb`.
- `restricted` (Boolean) Whether only users with an explicit permission can access the Component.
- `screenshot_filemask` (String) Path of screenshots relative to the repository root, such as `docs/screenshots/*.png`.
- `source_language` (String) Code of the language of the source strings, such as `en`, the default. Weblate cannot change it after create, so a change fails at plan; apply with `-replace` to delete the Component with its translations and create it again.
- `suggestion_autoaccept` (Number) Number of votes after which Weblate accepts a suggestion; `0` turns this off.
- `suggestion_voting` (Boolean) Whether users can vote on suggestions.
- `template` (String) Path of the base file of a monolingual format, which holds the source strings.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `variant_regex` (String) Regular expression that finds the variants of a string.
- `vcs` (String) Version control system, such as `git`. Defaults to `git`.
- `vcs_params` (String) Settings of the version control system as a JSON object, set with `jsonencode`.

### Read-Only

- `git_export` (String) URL from which users can fetch the changes in Weblate's copy of the repository.
- `id` (String) The slug path of the Component: the Project slug, the slugs of its Categories and its own slug, joined by `/`, such as `docs/guides/api`.
- `weblate_id` (Number) Numeric ID that Weblate gave the Component. It stays the same when the Component is renamed or moved, which lets the provider find a Component that was renamed outside OpenTofu.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the background task of a create, such as `30m`. Defaults to `20m`. When the time is up, the apply fails with the task's progress, the task goes on in Weblate, and the Component is in state.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for Weblate to delete the Component in the background, such as `30m`. Defaults to `20m`. When the time is up, the deletion goes on in Weblate.
- `update` (String) How long to wait for the background task of an update, such as `30m`. Defaults to `20m`. When the time is up, the apply fails with the task's progress and the task goes on in Weblate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the slug path of the Component, such as docs/guides/app.
terraform import weblate_component.app docs/guides/app
```
